items.title: What we know about the ground stop and what to do if you're affected
items.description: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.

items.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
items.description: The Ukrainian president says US envoys touted the exchange as part of efforts to end the war with Russia.

items.title: Italy fines Meta €805m over accessing users' photos
items.description: The social media giant is accused of not informing about 20 million users it had access to their photos.

items.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
items.description: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

items.title: Second catch attempt for SpaceX Starship rocket
items.description: The attempt follows an unsuccessful effort to catch of the rocket’s booster which instead came down in the ocean.

items.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
items.description: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.
